text: {"assertions":["A conflict loop was discovered in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift that appeared only on the first request after a cold start.","The root cause of the conflict loop was that the serializer was dropping fields it did not recognize, causing two clients to rewrite each other on every sync pass.","The conflict loop was fixed by switching to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields instead of dropping them.","The fix was implemented in PR #1469 on the branch fix/conflict-loop-1.","The conflict loop could be reproduced by editing the same note on two devices while offline.","After the fix was applied, p99 latency improved significantly from 9.3 seconds to 861 milliseconds."]}
